title: UK Payment Practices Reports (Large Companies, Days to Pay) — filters

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Current reports (default), or only the reports added, removed or changed since a date — schedule a daily run in changes mode to see each new report as it is filed and pay only for what changed.

since.title: Changes since
since.description: Changes mode only: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the last 7 days. The feed keeps 90 days.

change.title: Change type
change.description: Changes mode only: one kind of change. Default: all three.

company_number.title: Company number
company_number.description: Companies House number as the register writes it, e.g. 00519500 or SC123456 — every report the company has filed.

period_end_after.title: Reporting period ended on or after
period_end_after.description: Only reports for periods ending on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

filed_on_after.title: Filed on or after
filed_on_after.description: Only reports published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

average_days_to_pay_max.title: Average days to pay at most
average_days_to_pay_max.description: Prompt payers: reports whose average time to pay is at most this many days.

average_days_to_pay_min.title: Average days to pay at least
average_days_to_pay_min.description: Slow payers: reports whose average time to pay is at least this many days.

not_paid_within_terms_pct_min.title: Paid late: at least this % of invoices
not_paid_within_terms_pct_min.description: Reports where at least this share of invoices was not paid within the agreed terms.

paid_after_60_days_pct_min.title: Paid after 60 days: at least this %
paid_after_60_days_pct_min.description: Reports where at least this share of invoices took more than 60 days to pay.

participates_in_payment_codes.title: Payment code signatories only
participates_in_payment_codes.description: Tick for reports that declare membership of a payment code (Prompt Payment Code / Fair Payment Code).

e_invoicing_offered.title: Offers e-invoicing
e_invoicing_offered.description: Tick for reports that declare electronic invoicing is offered to suppliers.

supply_chain_financing_offered.title: Offers supply-chain finance
supply_chain_financing_offered.description: Tick for reports that declare supply-chain financing is offered to suppliers.

max_results.title: Maximum results
max_results.description: Stop after this many reports (you are charged per result).
